why: First clear gate found: two yellow posts with teal crossbars, sitting left-of-center in the forward view (roughly 20-45% across frame, opening center ~30%). The policy's proposed move decomposes to forward+RIGHT in the drone's own frame (trust only 0.45), which would drift away from the opening. Overriding: turn left ~20deg and move forward to center on the gap between the posts, small left strafe to help centering, holding altitude.
